settings.title: Order confirmed
settings.text: You get an email with your order number as soon as you've paid.

settings.title: Packed & dispatched
settings.text: Weekday orders before 13:00 leave us the same day. We email your Aramex tracking number.

settings.title: On its way
settings.text: Aramex delivers in 2–4 working days to main centres, and a little longer to outlying areas.

settings.title: Delivered
settings.text: The driver may SMS or call before arriving, so keep your phone close.

settings.heading: Track your order
settings.text: Every Homeward order ships with Aramex and comes with a tracking number.
